planets.name: TOI-654 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-654 with a 1.53-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-654 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-654. Its orbit and size follow Ikuta et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
